description: Today, Michael Whatley welcomed seniors and local officials to a roundtable in Wilmington focused on the No Tax on Social Security provision of the Working Families Tax Cut Act. Whatley and seniors discussed how the No Tax on Social Security has helped millions across North Carolina keep more of their money.

title: Michael Whatley Hosts No Tax on Social Security Roundtable in Wilmington – Michael Whatley for Senate
